final: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_analyst_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) AS mean_pair_average FROM pair_averages), kept AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.avg_analyst_count, p.avg_analyst_count - o.mean_pair_average AS margin FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_analyst_count > o.mean_pair_average), by_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_analyst_count) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(margin) AS avg_margin FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst_count, avg_margin, avg_analyst_count / (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) FROM by_type) AS relative_avg_analyst_count FROM by_type
